text:
```yaml
name: Check Branch Alias

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - master

jobs:
  check-branch-alias:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Check branch alias
        run: |
          # Extract branch alias from composer.json
          BRANCH_ALIAS=$(jq -r '.extra."branch-alias"."dev-main"' composer.json)
          
          # Validate branch alias format
          if [[ ! "$BRANCH_ALIAS" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.x-dev$ ]]; then
            echo "Error: Branch alias '$BRANCH_ALIAS' does not match expected format 'X.Y.x-dev'"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check if this is a release branch (should have a specific pattern)
          if [[ "$BRANCH_ALIAS" == *"x-dev" ]]; then
            echo "Branch alias appears to be a development version: $BRANCH_ALIAS"
          else
            echo "Branch alias appears to be a release version: $BRANCH_ALIAS"
          fi
          
          echo "Branch alias validation passed: $BRANCH_ALIAS"
```
